status: editable design and pure helper; production executor and attack/render adapters pending

authority.userRequest: About60 enchants, including large size, bloodsteal, fire, living weapon, sharp, extremely small, slippery.
authority.authoredChoices: Names, Tier1..5 ordering, bounded effect parameters, physical-item capabilities and proposed one slot are editable game design.

wheel.label: Enchantment
wheel.order: weakest-to-strongest along the pointer sampling direction
wheel.tierMass: not reserved; tiers annotate strength only

contract.gate: active owned weapon + final effective Weapon Mastery>=5 + compatible unused slot
contract.bonusTiming: Effective mastery = immutable retained raw base + distinct matching final modifiers; signed, unbounded.
contract.repeat: Resolve once per slot; saved frozen result consumes its slot atomically with the trait. Resume never redraws a consumed slot.
contract.effects: Weapon-local traits only. No main-stat/mastery modifier, owner power, weapon/race grant or other wheel invocation.
contract.size: Only selected weapon changes; owner Size wheel/result stays unchanged. Geometric scale does not invent owner stats/body fit.
contract.attack: Enchant augments the existing weapon attack/delivery; does not create unlimited ammo, attacks, target eligibility, or an owner power.
contract.bloodsteal: Needs a successful wounding hit on a blood-bearing target; minor healing, no victim-count wheel or Vampire rewards.
contract.living: Same weapon instance gains bounded autonomous behavior; no separate companion/race/grant or secondary mastery.
contract.funny: Only an actual tagged Enchant result supplies the existing Shrek funny-result hook; once by actual spin ID, never fixed/replayed/preview results.
contract.equalizer: Uniform after hard compatibility/disabled/slot/ownership filters; no threshold or draw-count change.
contract.emptyPool: needs_configuration, no fallback, None, or silent skipped reward
contract.externalDefinitions: Unbound early/mount/companion/Mecha definitions need an explicit adapter binding. Never infer artifact compatibility from a name or narrative.
contract.replay: Freeze versions, eligibility/capability snapshot, final projection proof, normalized leaf pool and recipe before external RNG. Replay uses frozen plan.
